templates.evidence_request_damage: Thank you for reporting the damage and for the photo(s) you sent. To process your case quickly, please also send a photo of the outer packaging (the box) as it arrived. One photo showing the box condition is enough.
templates.resolution_replacement: We're sorry your item arrived damaged. We're sending a replacement as soon as we confirm the remaining evidence.
templates.resolution_wrong_item: We're sorry about the mix-up. We're shipping the correct item today and have emailed you a prepaid return label for the incorrect one.
templates.resolution_refund: We're sorry for the inconvenience. A refund has been issued to your original payment method.
templates.acknowledgement: Thank you for reaching out. We've received your complaint and are reviewing it now.
